evidence: contract test PASS (35 tests); without-baseline 0.30 (a plain answer treats the map as a lookup table and reads the hot case straight off the mounting temperature, so the whole self-heating rise is dropped and a junction that settles above its rating reads as compliant; it grades the sweep on point count alone, so a sweep that stops short of a service extreme or steps straight over a knee passes while every number read off it inherits the gap; it accepts a forward drop that rises with temperature as device behaviour rather than as lead and fixture resistance dominating the bench; and it interpolates reverse leakage linearly although leakage moves multiplicatively, which sits the mid-interval value well under the curve)
